title: Cheating Dad Murdered Secret Girlfriend to Cover Up Affair
description:
Multiple bodycam and surveillance videos caught the moments leading up to the death of a Minnesota woman. Alex Pennig was shot shortly after she returned home from a bar where her boyfriend and secret lover, who is married, got into a scuffle. Detectives arrived at the crime scene after Matthew Ecker called 911 in a panic. Investigators later uncovered numerous inconsistencies in his story and undeniable evidence that broke the case. Get the full story on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
